select pke.*, p.name as product_name, p.product_no, pk.title as knowledge_title, pkc.chunk_title, pkc.chunk_content from product_knowledge_embedding pke left join product p on pke.product_id = p.id left join product_knowledge pk on pke.knowledge_id = pk.id left join product_knowledge_chunk pkc on pke.chunk_id = pkc.id
and pke.chunk_id = #{chunkId} and pke.knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} and pke.product_id = #{productId} and pke.embedding_status = #{embeddingStatus} and p.name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%') and pk.title like concat('%', #{knowledgeTitle}, '%') and pkc.chunk_title like concat('%', #{chunkTitle}, '%') and pkc.chunk_content like concat('%', #{chunkContent}, '%')
order by pke.id desc
